messages:
maria: Can we lift the SDK v1.4.2 compatibility pin for runtime 3.2 on Dedicated? Planning a canary tonight 20:30 PT. @jamal can you confirm kvcache/longseq behavior?
jamal: Ran a quick perf sweep on staging. KV cache seems okay but saw a small p99 bump for longseq (4096). Not a showstopper but worth watching.
jamal: Test summary: p50 ~ 30ms, p99 220ms -> 235ms (regression ~6.8%). Command used:
```bash
tools/loadtest --model llama3q --seq 4096 --concurrency 8 --runtime 3.2-canary
```
sophia: Oncall noticed an earlier stress spike in error budget during the nightly run. Not a blocker if we have auto-rollback thresholds, but I prefer we stabilize kvcache evict flake first.
ci-bot: Integration tests: 2 failing flakes detected (session-timeout, kv-cache-evict). Logs: https://ci/internal/build/5443
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for 2026-03-20T20:30:00Z. Plan: 5% -> 25% over 15m. Confirm with :thumbsup: to proceed.
alex: Proposal: run 5% canary with routing fallback to runtime 3.1 variant for failures, enable KV cache warmup on canary nodes. Auto-rollback rules: p99 > 300ms OR error rate > 0.5% -> rollback immediately. Rollback window 30m.
maria: I'm 👎 until the kv-cache-evict test is addressed. Prefer patch-first.
jamal: I'll try a quick fix for the kv-cache-evict race in staging and rerun tests by 19:30 PT. ETA ~45m.
sophia: Agree with auto-rollback and add an alert for kv-hit-rate dropping below 95%.
deploy-bot: Awaiting approval from @maria or @alex to start the canary.
alex: I can approve once jamal posts green and CI re-runs clean. I'll be on standby during the window.
maria: Update: jamal posted green ✅ — p99 now 228ms, kv-eject test passing locally. CI flake retried.
ci-bot: Rerun: 3/3 passed. test-run-id: tr-20260320-11.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: 5% -> 15% (15m) -> 50% (30m). Monitoring: https://dash/internal/canary/1759993333
sophia: Observed initial 5% slight p99 bump to ~240ms but within alex thresholds. Watching dashboards.
jamal: KV cache hit-rate improved to 98.7% after warmup; no error correlation with runtime change.
alex: Holding final lift until 50% completes and metrics stable for 15m. If stable, we'll lift pin and publish release note. Ops: prepare drain plan.
maria: 50% stable for 20m, lifting pin now. Action: update deploy-bot pinlist to remove SDK v1.4.2 restriction for runtime 3.2 on Dedicated.
deploy-bot: Pinlist updated. Release-note entry created: "Lifted SDK v1.4.2 runtime pin for runtime 3.2 on Dedicated; canary passed. See changelog: https://changelog/internal/1759993333"
maria: Thanks all. FYI @product: note minor latency blip in internal release notes so support knows to expect customer questions.
product-bot: Noted and added an item to the internal release draft.
alex: Great coordination — no rollback needed. Closing thread."
